caption: The drawing depicts two wooden hand tools, each with an angled metal blade inserted into the top, set against a plain, off-white background. The tools are colored in shades of brown, resembling wood grain, and contain a few darker accents indicating shadows and depth. The upper tool has a more detailed, profile shape with carved contours, and the blade is set at about a 45-degree angle. The lower tool is simpler in profile with a straighter, rectangular form and also holds a blade at a similar angle. In the center of the page, between the two tools, there are two small line drawings depicting front and side views of the tool’s cross-section in a faint, gray color. The overall composition is centered, with the two larger tool illustrations aligned vertically and the smaller technical line drawings situated between them. The background is otherwise unadorned.
title: Rabbet Plane
